verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe two ways Claude operates a browser for the user: the built-in browser in Cowork, where Claude opens sites, reads pages, clicks, types, and fills forms, and the Claude in Chrome extension, which reads, clicks, and navigates websites. Cowork also frames this as completing multi-step tasks on the user's behalf. The community items found are not about browser operation and are ignored. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of reliability on real-world web tasks.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can have the assistant operate a web browser on my behalf to research and complete tasks on websites

citations.quote: Claude opens sites, reads pages, clicks, types, and fills forms while you watch, with no need to switch windows.
Claude in Chrome is a browser extension that allows Claude to read, click, and navigate websites alongside you.
Claude can take on complex, multi-step tasks and execute them on your behalf.
